coverLetter:
Tomas Brandt
Chicago, IL, USA
tomas.brandt@example.com
+1 555 0123

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
GitLab

Dear Hiring Manager,

Forecasts only help engineering and finance leaders if they track what the business is actually doing. At Calder Industrial Components, our forecast for the larger business unit kept missing, so I rebuilt the model around order backlog and lifted its accuracy from 88% to 96%. Your Cloud Hosting role asks for the same thing: forecast models that reflect actual results and business drivers.

As a Financial Analyst, I own the monthly forecast and variance reporting for two business units with combined revenue of about 85 million USD, and I've done month-end reporting for five years. I also shortened our close reporting from 9 working days to 6 by automating journal checks in Excel VBA. I haven't managed cloud or AI vendor spend, but I'm strong in the underlying work: variance analysis, working with detailed data from SAP and Power BI, and turning numbers into a clear story for plant managers. At Redfern Stores I found a supplier rebate nobody was claiming, worth about 120,000 USD a year, because I kept digging into a variance until it made sense. I'm also working towards my ACCA, with 9 of 13 papers passed.

Your team works remotely and asynchronously, which suits how I like to work: own the deliverable, flag risks early and write things up clearly. I'd welcome a conversation about how I can support your cloud and AI infrastructure planning, and I'm available to start a discussion whenever suits your team.

Best regards,
Tomas Brandt
